rows.reasoning: At the federal level only own words count. Owens says a district that "conceals a child’s gender transition from their parents will lose federal funding" and that parents have "the ultimate right to make decisions", which places him on the parental side but does not establish either "Require schools to notify parents" or "Require parental permission before staff use a different name or pronouns"; his votes on H.R. 2616 and H.R. 5 are records that cannot seat a chair at this level, and their consent clause covers school forms rather than staff use.
